summary: 9F Inc. (NASDAQ: JFU) filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited first-half 2026 results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Total net revenues fell 48.3% year over year to RMB78.7 million (US$11.6 million) on weaker order volume and contraction of institutional partners' businesses. Reported net income rose to RMB704.6 million (US$103.8 million) versus RMB218.6 million, driven chiefly by unrealized mark-to-market gains on wealth-management products held for cash management, not operations. Adjusted net income was RMB153.9 million. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations mechanics are present; this is a routine earnings release, not a corporate action.
